title: Control-plane HTTP client does not honor HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY

worker.report:
The test passes with the fix. I made the fix before running the test on the old code, so I never watched it fail. The old transport left `Proxy` as `nil`, which the test's `tr.Proxy == nil` check would catch.

The fix is one line: `newTransport` now sets `Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment`. That covers both `NewTransport` and `NewDiscoveryTransport`. I didn't look at the data-plane transport in `internal/remotehelper/transport/proxy.go` that the issue mentions.

Test added: `TestTransportsHonorProxyEnvironment`
Files changed: `internal/entireclient/httpclient/transport.go`, `internal/entireclient/httpclient/proxy_test.go` (new)
